title: Python Ast Instanceof
objective: Use declared host instance_of primitive for compiler AST type checks

handoff.summary: Assign the compiler-private is_node_type export directly to existing js.js_instanceof, avoiding a wrapper and its dispatch. Native behavior diagnostics pass. Earlier runtime.instance_of import and imported-alias candidates failed immutable stage-zero import resolution and export discovery respectively; both were abandoned without loader changes. The explicit assignment passed immutable seed compiler import/export emission preflight. This contract is frozen before the assignment candidate bootstrap build; final results go in the PR without contract mutation.
risks: No performance gain is claimed until controlled comparison.
Private helper introspection now identifies js_instanceof from js instead of the former ast_types wrapper; repository search found no consumers of the old metadata.
Full compiler/integration and multi-platform qualification remain governed by their declared checks; focused diagnostics do not replace them.
next_steps: Run full self-hosting build and direct focused, CST, portable and strict checks on frozen source.
Inspect bootstrap primitive emission and module closure before measuring exact baseline/candidate artifacts.
